about.title: Hi, I'm Alessio Bellan
about.p1: I study marketing and have been developing websites for a few years, mostly learning by working on real projects. I'm interested in understanding how things work, from code to communication, and finding solutions when things get stuck.
about.p2: Before being a freelancer, I am the president of ABBO APS, a third-sector association for digital education. That's where I really started building sites and tools, and that's where the way I work now comes from.
about.quote: I work best when I truly understand what is needed, not when I follow a template.
about.footer: 10% of the proceeds from each project supports ABBO APS.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How long does it take to complete the project?
faq.a1: It depends on the request: from one week for a simple site, up to a few months for more complex projects like a custom management system.
faq.a2: In the first week, revisions are unlimited. After delivery, you can choose between pay-as-you-go revisions (€30 + €45/h) or a flat monthly rate of €85 for unlimited modifications over time.
faq.q3: Do you manage the domain and hosting?
faq.a3: The domain always remains your property and under your management. I can take care of hosting, but only after we discuss what is really needed.
faq.q4: What happens after delivery if something breaks?
faq.a4: In the first month after delivery, support and bug fixes are on me, at no extra cost. Actual modifications follow the revision options.
faq.q5: What is the difference between the packages?
faq.a5: There are no locked features by tier: the difference is simply how much you want to invest in the project — more budget, more time and care we can dedicate to design and details.
faq.a6: Yes. For an e-commerce, contact me directly for a custom quote, because needs vary greatly from case to case.
faq.a7: Deposit at the start of the project, balance upon delivery.
faq.q8: Do I have to provide the content?
faq.a8: You can provide texts and photos, or I can take care of it — it depends on the project. Professional copy and photography, if requested, are quoted separately.
faq.q9: If I need to change a text or a photo later, is it included?
faq.a9: Small changes (up to about 30 minutes of work) are always free.
faq.q10: Do you also work with those who don't have clear ideas?
faq.a10: I work with those who want to tell something real. We develop ideas together: the starting point is you and your story, the rest we build together.
